sources.name: pplibraries.org
sources.notes: The library's activities page embeds five public Google calendars; this is the one named 'Elizabeth Events' (647 events, 177 recurring, America/Denver). calendar.google.com's robots.txt disallows everything for agents it does not list, so ingest will not read it until the editor sets robots: subscribe; the library publishes the calendars for exactly this kind of subscription. Found 4 October 2026.
